name: plain-view
description: A quiet transcript: tool rows step aside and the agent's plan shows as a card above the prompt, with the current step, progress bars and a summary when the turn ends

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Hide successful tool rows and show the plan card above the prompt. Failures, permission dialogs and the agent's questions always show in full. /plain-view on and off change it too

agentText.title: The agent's words
agentText.description: What stays of the agent's messages in the transcript while the mod is on. final: the text of a step that went on to call tools steps aside, so the final answer stays. none: no message. card: no message, and the end card carries the answer's first sentence. all: every message. Failures, permission dialogs and the agent's questions always show

palette.title: Bar colors
palette.description: The gradient of the progress bars and the request's title. /plain-view palette shows each one with a sample

animation.title: Animated bars
animation.description: A shine runs along the bars while the agent works. Off: still bars in the theme's own colors, with no gradient

askForTasks.title: Ask for a task list
askForTasks.description: While the mod is on, one line in the system prompt asks the model to keep a task list (TodoWrite or TaskCreate) for work of more than two steps, so the card shows each step. Costs a few tokens per request. Off: the card reads the list the model keeps on its own, or a checklist in its answer

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the card and the messages. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

icons.title: Icons in the terminal
icons.description: emoji draws the steps as ✅ 🟠 ⚪; symbol draws them as ✓ ● ○ for terminals that draw emoji at odd widths; auto uses symbol in a JetBrains IDE's terminal and emoji elsewhere
